name: sandbox-mode
description: Sandbox mode: a site built from biome/difficulty/seed starts from nothing, honours the seed, and is fully playable through to a blast (#504: 3-control setup).

steps.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite difficulty:hard seed:777 staffed:true
steps.description: No new_game first — a sandbox site is created from nothing, which is the point of the mode. #553: staffed:true (sandbox start supports the same flag as new_game, Sandbox.ts) hires a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence and buys an unmanned drill_rig for free — automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite difficulty:hard seed:777 staffed:true

steps.description: Biome and seed should match what was asked for. Grid extents are the fixed 64x32x64 default regardless of request (#504).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:4 depth:6 start:14,17
steps.description: #553: shrunk from the original rows:3 cols:3 (9 holes, start:20,20) to 2x2 (4 holes) so the single driller/drill_rig lands the whole plan quickly -- this file's point is a full drill/charge/sequence/blast cycle actually working, not a specific hole count. #1151: moved from start:10,10 to start:14,17. Under the 30-degree slope gate this alpine_granite/777 site is 76% climb-reachable from the crew (3117 of 4096 cells) and all four of the old plan's holes sat in the stranded quarter -- measured with computeClimbReachableSet from the driller's spawn at (18,15): every one of (10,10) (14,10) (10,14) (14,14) unreachable, so no driller could ever claim them and the plan stalled at holder:null forever. alpine_granite is a recorded 48.2%-reachable mountain biome (NAV_MAX_SLOPE_DEGREES comment, balance.ts) -- designed difficulty, not a regression -- so the remedy is to site the plan on ground the crew can walk, per #1151's own Test section. All four holes of start:14,17 are reachable and the plan lands at tick 66.

#553: drain the ordered plan -- the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes. #1151: was a hand-measured `tick 60` pad (landing measured at tick 45 under the old whole-voxel climb rule); under the 30-degree slope gate the same plan lands at tick 66, so the pad expired one beat early and every later step cascaded. Replaced with a waitUntil on the thing actually being waited for, per dev-scenario-authoring -- a stall now fails loudly and by name instead of silently handing the next step an undrilled plan.

expect.note: All 4 holes have landed -- none lost, none left ordered forever.

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.
A second site with a different biome, difficulty and seed, to confirm the mode can be re-entered.

expect.note: difficulty:easy starts at $250,000 (SANDBOX_DIFFICULTIES.easy.startingCash, Sandbox.ts) -- grid extents stay the fixed 64x32x64 default (#504) regardless of biome/difficulty, same as the first site.
